notes.title: Confess My Love and Transparent Black in Russian are available!
notes.content:
Many thanks to RedKittens for translating Confess My Love and Transparent Black into Russian!
You can now enjoy the story of Willie, Lisa and Yael in official translation of Russian from RedKittens.
Please tend to the discussions if you have any problems with the game.

notes.title: Spanish version online!
notes.content:
Well, maybe I should have written this post in authentic Spanish, but I'm really not good at it. So, many thanks to TheCrazyVagrant for translating this game into Spanish!

And, it you havent tried out our new game, here's the link:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/757180/Wolf__Rabbit/
We're not sure how long it will take before we can finally have a Spanish edition there, but we will try our best.

Let's enjoy this update!

——dspzzy

notes.title: Any particular interest in a DLC? / 扩展包已上线。
notes.content:
It seems that we are always late making a broadcast, though I guess it's just fine to be cautious while advertising for a downloadable content. So, what's new here?
某人貌似谈崩了，慈善包貌似要不曾存在过了，算了反正一折以下的游戏本来就是邪道（喂），但是玩家依旧可以通过以下途径对制作组进行捐款：

http://store.steampowered.com/app/790520/Transparent_Black__Wish/

Cheap as always, this DLC introduced the official origins of the game series, emm, is there a game series yet...? Whatever.
As promised, you can unlock this content for free by achieving at least 10 out of 11 steam achievements in this game.
从游戏体验角度来说，您无需购买此DLC也可通过解锁本游戏至少10枚steam成就以开启追加剧情。

It is recommended by original developer to experience the extra scenario in the order that Touch the Mirror Without a Knife -> Touch the Mirror With a Knife to get two different endings. There aren't much differences though.
原则上推荐的游玩顺序：开启附赠房后，出门撞镜子，玩穿以后拿刀撞镜子。但是前者的流程推进线索少到了不能用微妙来形容的地步，所以……

No soul is wasted during the game developing, guaranteed by a powerful devil lord, who insisted himself having nothing to do with this event.
【无码剧透】酒驾司机的故事是铁定不会做成一份游戏了。这次故事把原作世界观直接挖出了一小半来，某人怕不是该回去补充设定了（笑）。

——dspzzy
